title: Portable Git-native feature/release branch distillation and snapshot composition
goal: Deliver portable Git-native selective branch composition (`local-distill` / `xtask::distill_compose`) implementing CEO Mandate 73 and board item 113 step 2: read task manifests directly from Git commits across `.agents/tasks/{,done/,in-progress/}`, compute dependency closures, consume `distill` (`susi-distill-plan/v1`) or `susi-feature-manifest-v1` inputs, compose conflict-free candidate trees via 3-way `git merge-tree --write-tree` without leaking unselected `main` commits, optionally execute hermetic shell-free `accept.cmd` checks in ephemeral credential-stripped worktrees, publish create-only `refs/tags/susi-distill/<name>` snapshots, and emit fsynced `susi-distillation-receipt-v1` receipts with zero GitHub service dependency.
limitations: Distillation composes audited candidate branches and create-only snapshot tags (`refs/tags/susi-distill/<name>`); full dual-host release qualification across Linux x86_64 and Windows x86_64 remains a separate downstream qualification gate on frozen snapshots.
Pre-existing unrelated `lean_core_ceilings` failure on `susi-gemi` (21305 > 21290 from commit 364600b95) observed on base aa4d69846 and owned by peer branch `local-agent/claudegemiceiling`.
